messages:
anya: dropping the latest Figma for the Deployments timeline + canary preview. want eyeballs on a11y and the rollback affordance before tomorrow's design review. link: https://www.figma.com/file/example/deploy-timeline samuel: looks clean. quick Q: when a canary increments (e.g., 10% -> 25%) is that announced to screen readers? keyboard focus flow? anya: good point. current idea: an off-screen live announcer that describes state changes (small concise text), and focus only moves when a user triggers explicit rollback. otherwise we don't steal focus on each update. kevin: +1 to not stealing focus. also FYI: if we spam aria-live for every minor tick we could flood SR output. prefer aria-live='polite' + aria-atomic='true' for incremental updates. for critical events (rollback completed / failure) use a dedicated assertive message. jordan: accessibility recs from QA side: - use aria-live='polite' for canary % updates - use aria-live='assertive' for rollback success/failure and outage-level fallbacks - announce succinct copy: e.g., "Canary 3: version v2.1 rolled out to 25 percent" not raw JSON - ensure timeline nodes are focusable (tabindex=0) and have visible focus styles - provide skip link to jump to 'active rollout' region for keyboard users jordan: suggested announcer snippet: ```html
``` and when we need to push a critical banner: ```html
Rollback completed for version v2.1: traffic reverted to v1.9
``` kevin: that matches what I can implement. minor perf note: keep DOM updates to a single innerText change instead of re-rendering the whole tree so SRs read cleanly. anya: microcopy suggestions based on jordan's phrasing: - canary updates: "Canary rollouts: v2.1 at 25%" - rollback CTA: primary label = "Rollback to v1.9" (confirm modal copy: "Are you sure you want to rollback to v1.9? This will reroute traffic immediately.") - timeline tooltip: "Deployed v2.1 — stable since 12:14 UTC" samuel: one UX nit: the rollback CTA sits inline with the version chip now. can we move it to the adaptive actions area so accidental clicks are reduced on touch? also show an undo snackbar for 10s after rollback with keyboard shortcut info. anya: yes, plan: move CTA into overflow on small viewports, visible action on hover/focus for desktop. add undo snackbar with `Esc` to dismiss and `Ctrl+Z` for keyboard undo (we'll document exact shortcut in help). deploy-bot: automated note: staging canary rollout started by @ci for stack/service-x — v2.1 -> 10% at 2026-03-22T14:12:05Z qa-bot: I'll run axe and voiceover smoke tests against the prototype. tagging @jordan. will upload results as a comment in the review thread by EOD. jordan: quick color contrast check — the timeline active dot uses #4F9AE6 on white; contrast ratio ~3.5:1. need to bump to at least 4.5:1 or add a 2px border for sufficient contrast. also ensure focus ring is 3px and visible in high-contrast mode. kevin: noted. I can add an outline fallback for high-contrast. also will throttle announcer updates to once per 2s during rapid traffic shifts so SRs don't get spammed. anya: action items: - kevin: implement live region + throttling + focusable nodes (PR by Thu) - jordan: run full a11y sweep and post issues (ETA EOD) - qa-bot: attach axe/vo test outputs to the Figma thread - samuel/anya: finalize microcopy and CTA placement before design review samuel: thanks — if we make those changes today we can demo the keyboard flow in the review. :thumbsup: anya: thanks everyone. I'll update the Figma and push a new prototype link in ~2 hours.
